name: program-runtime.delegated-run
purpose: Start the same governed Agent Manager workflow twice without blocking, then collect each run once and report the evidence row's keys; the delegation construction pattern.

request.description: {owner, workflow_key, input}. Default: the development-toolchain-validator skill-experiment-audit smoke request.

assumptions: the workflow_key names a workflow its owner declares; an unknown key is a typed failure (workflow_rejected)
the session carries a delegated-run spend ceiling; reaching it is a refusal (delegated_run_spend_exceeded)
invariants: exactly two starts and at most two collects; no polling, no retry
the envelope is printed exactly once, on every path

signals.first_row_keys: keys of the last collected evidence row

budget.async_reason: wall_ms exceeds the 120 s synchronous submission bound; submit with --async and wait once

fixtures.note: Expects the status the program should produce. On 2026-09-02 the delegation bridge is broken: agent.start returned NOT_FOUND_WORKFLOWREVISION for development-toolchain-validator/skill-experiment-audit (the smoke workflow is no longer declared) and, before that, schema_mismatch on the workflow input; the live run therefore ends failed/workflow_rejected until the bridge route lands (program-runtime-improve §5 delegation-live). A fixture never pins that broken outcome.
